Hi ,

 

Hope you are doing fine.

 

We have an Urgent opening.  Please go through the Job Description below and let us know if your skills match the requirement of our client.

 

       

Role : Compensation and Payroll Technical Business Analyst

Location : NYC, NY

Duration : Short Term

Job Description :
 
looking for a Compensation Business Analyst to join its HR IT Rewards team.   The team is responsible for managing a number of key systems related to Compensation Management, and is about to embark on a strategic, multiyear initiative, in which the candidate will play a key role.  The ideal candidate would be a subject matter expert on Compensation processes used in the Financial industry, have a good understanding of all aspects of the Software Development Life cycle and be well versed in business analysis and technical writing.
 
Responsibilities Review, analyze and create detailed documentation for compensation systems and processes Map and re-engineer business processes for optimization Elicit and document business requirements for the new compensation system Conduct fit-gap analysis for vendor products against requirements Write detailed functional design documents including wire frames for the new screens, business rules, etc. Design testing strategy and write test cases for new system functionality
 
Requirements 7+ years of experience with designing and implementing enterprise-wide HR systems 5+ years of experience with Compensation business processes and systems 5+ years of experience working with HR ERP systems such as Workday, People Soft, Taleo , etc 5+ years of experience in all aspects of business analysis function including business process mapping, requirements gathering, functional design and testing Experience designing and implementation compensation models is a plus Good understanding of all aspects of the Software Development Life cycle Good Excel skills, and analytical skills Proven time management skills are a must, as is the ability to work at candidate's own direction and balance competing priorities and customer needs Candidate must be detail oriented, self-starter with proven written and verbal communication skills. Able to communicate effectively, to structure complicated thoughts in a clear and concise manner and have an approachable personality.
